summary.text: CHAUDHRYS AS is a private limited company registered in Finstadjordet, founded 2022-08-08. CHAUDHRYS AS sells goods and services within the operation of street kitchens and other activities that naturally coincide with this, as well as participation in other companies, investments and related business. Its main industry code is 56.110: restaurant activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 4 348 603 NOK and the annual result was -199 171 NOK; operating income was up from 4 235 539 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from -73 712 NOK in 2024 to -199 171 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 243 580 NOK in 2024 to 44 410 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Chaudhry Zia Akhtar (styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 7 on 2025-12-12 to 5 on 2026-07-16. The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-16 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
